sad.quote: Tears are words that need to be written.
sad.author: Paulo Coelho
sad.reflection: It takes courage to admit you're sad. You don't need to force a smile or rush to fix how you feel right now. Your sadness is not a sign of failure—it is simply proof that something matters deeply to you.
sad.groundingExercise: Place one hand over your chest. Feel the steady rhythm of your breathing. Take three long, unhurried breaths, releasing your shoulders on each exhale.

tired.quote: Rest is not a reward you earn after finishing everything. It is a biological necessity you deserve right now.
tired.author: Dr. Saundra Dalton-Smith
tired.reflection: Fatigue isn't just physical—it's emotional, mental, and sensory. When you have been strong for too long, resting is your act of self-preservation. It is safe to lay your armor down for a while.
tired.groundingExercise: Unclench your jaw. Drop your tongue away from the roof of your mouth. Let your eyes soften and give yourself permission to do absolutely nothing for the next sixty seconds.

disconnected.quote: You are not a drop in the ocean. You are the entire ocean in a drop.
disconnected.author: Rumi
disconnected.reflection: Feeling numb or detached is your nervous system's way of protecting you when things become too loud or too much. Even if you feel far away from yourself right now, your anchor is still here.
disconnected.groundingExercise: Name three physical sensations right now: the temperature of the air against your skin, the weight of your feet on the floor, and the feel of the device in your hands. You are here.

heavy.quote: You do not have to carry everything that happened yesterday, today.
heavy.author: Morgan Harper Nichols
heavy.reflection: When life feels like a crushing weight, remember that you are only asked to live this single minute. You don't have to solve tomorrow, next week, or next year in this room.
heavy.groundingExercise: Take a deep inhale through your nose for four counts, hold gently for two, then exhale with a soft sigh through your mouth for six. Imagine putting down a heavy backpack.

broken.quote: The wound is the place where the Light enters you.
broken.author: Rumi
broken.reflection: Being in pieces does not mean you are ruined. Ceramic repaired with gold is celebrated for its fractures. The pain you are feeling right now is raw, but you are not beyond repair. You are still whole underneath.
broken.groundingExercise: Gently wrap both arms around yourself in a comforting hold. Remind yourself softly: 'I am safe in this moment. I have survived every hard day before this.'

loss.quote: Grief, I've learned, is really just love. It's all the love you want to give, but cannot. All that unspent love gathers up in the corners of your eyes, the lump in your throat, and in that hollow part of your chest.
loss.author: Jamie Anderson
loss.reflection: Whether you are grieving a person, a relationship, an opportunity, or an earlier version of yourself, that emptiness hurts because it mattered. Give yourself infinite gentleness today.
loss.groundingExercise: Rest your hands palms-up on your lap. Breathe in peace, breathe out tension. Allow yourself to honor what was, without having to explain it to anyone.
